'''Erindax''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who lived [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire. Erindax created the [[skyslasher]], a flying predator, as a hobby in his interest in creating new [[Species/Legends|species]], but he lost control of the flock of creatures and he was blinded in one [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. In response, Erindax engineered future skyslashers to be almost blind.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Erindax was mentioned in the Codex entry for skyslashers in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], but the entry was cut before the game's release.<ref name="Codex" />
